City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 20, 2015 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation regarding the 2015 San Diego County Fair.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 4/27/15 Special Meeting, 4/29/15 Special Meeting and 5/9/15 Special Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-05-20 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2015-05-20 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
The renewal of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
1) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015-19, a Resolution of Intention to order the renewal of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District for FY 2015-16; and 2) Set the public hearing for June 10, 2015.
2015-05-20 Item 8C - Renewal of the ELLD
8D.
Consideration of all-way stop control at the intersection of Hygeia Avenue and Cereus Street. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Blough
1) Review the information included in this agenda report and provide staff direction on the installation of an all-way stop at the intersection of Hygeia Avenue and Cereus Street; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2015-31 and direct staff to install an all-way stop at the intersection of Hygeia Avenue and Cereus Street.
2015-05-20 Item 8D - Hygeia and Cereus All Way Stop
8E.
Appointments to the Youth Commission. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
The Mayor, with the approval of City Council, appoint the ten applicants to the Youth Commission with terms ending June 2016.
2015-05-20 Item 8E - Youth Commission Appointments
8F.
Adopt City Resolution No. 2015-27 adding $190,000 to the FY2014-15 Governmental/Educational Access Fund Capital Improvement Project budget and authorize the City Manager to execute a contract with STC Traffic, Inc. for buildout of the City's Institutional Fiber Optic Communications Network. Contact Person: Information Technology Supervisor Labarrere
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2015-27 adding $190,000 to the FY 2014-15 Governmental/Educational Access Fund CIP Budget; and 2)Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract with STC Traffic, Inc. to provide engineering and permitting documents, communication system purchasing and implementation, and project management services for the City Fiber Optic Communications Network.
2015-05-20 Item 8F - Fiber Optic Communications Network
8G.
Cottonwood Creek Watershed Low-Impact Development (LID) Retrofit Plan. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Villa
1) Receive staff's presentation and approve the Cottonwood Creek Watershed Low-Impact Development (LID) Retrofit Plan; and 2) Authorize the Director of Public Works to apply for future stormwater grant funding as it becomes available in order to implement the projects identified in the plan.
2015-05-20 Item 8G - Cottonwood Creek Watershed Low Impact Development Retrofit Plan and Approval (Part 1)
2015-05-20 Item 8G - Cottonwood Creek Watershed Low Impact Development Retrofit Plan and Approval (Part 2)
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Appointment of two tenant commissioners to the Housing Authority. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
The Mayor, with approval from the City Council, appoint two tenant commissioners to the Housing Authority with terms ending June 2017.
2015-05-20 Item 10A -Housing Authority Tenant Commissioners Appointment
10B.
Caltrans Sustainable Transportation Planning Grant to develop the Encinitas Rail Corridor Vision Plan. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Villa
1) Accept the Caltrans Sustainable Transportation Planning Grant in order to develop the Encinitas Rail Corridor Vision Plan; 2) Adopt Resolution 2015-24; 3) Authorize appropriation of grant funding in the amount of $175,000 to the Encinitas Rail Corridor Vision Plan project, Project No. WC15A; and 4) Provide staff direction related to information to be contained in a Request for Proposal for consultant services.
2015-05-20 Item 10B - Encinitas Rail Corridor Vision Plan
10C.
Selection of Coastal Rail Trail Preferred Alignment. Contact Person: Deputy Director Deane
1) Approve Staff recommendation for the preferred alignment of the Coastal Rail Trail; 2) Provide Staff direction on modifications to the Coastal Rail Trail; and 3) Direct Staff to notify the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) of the City Council preferred alignment.
2015-05-20 Item 10C - Coastal Rail Trail
10D.
Review Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 9.28: Possession of alcohol at beaches, parks and waterways. Contact Person: Management Analyst Roff
1) Discuss amending EMC 9.28 to prohibit alcohol possession at all parks except by special event (public moderate or major events) permit only; and 2) Direct the City Manager to return with an ordinance to codify the recommended amendments.
2015-05-20 Item 10D - Alcohol at Beaches, Parks and Waterways EMC 9.28 (Updated Page 2)
10E.
Proposed 2016 Major Special Events review and selection. Contact Person: Management Analyst Roff
City Council review of Major Special Events proposed for 2016.
2015-05-20 Item 10E - 2016 Proposed Major Special Events
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.

CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
